paragraphs.text: The Ath Mountains are a chain of low, misty mountains north of Llanowar . They lie on the continent of Aerona , part of the Domains on the plane of Dominaria .

The Ath Mountains lie to the northwest of the Llanowar elfhame of Ruadach and serve as its northern border. The mountains also border Staprion and Loridalh in the north, and separate the domains of the elves from the orcs of the Ironclaw Mountains further to the east and north. Along the edge of the forest, groves of oak trees entwined with the rare Taradomnu vine grow.
